channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: Flávio lidera no 2º turno em SP; Lula é o 1º com folga na BA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads a potential runoff against President Lula (PT) in São Paulo, according to a Genial/Quaest poll. In the first round, the two candidates are tied within the poll's two-point margin of error. The survey also shows Lula with a clear lead in the first round in Bahia.

item.title: Marina e Tebet lideram corrida ao Senado por SP, diz Genial/Quaest
item.description: Marina Silva (Rede) and Simone Tebet (PSB) lead voting intentions for the São Paulo Senate seats, with 14% and between 11% and 12% respectively, according to the Genial/Quaest poll from July 2026. The survey, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, interviewed 1,650 voters between July 23 and 27. Both candidates are the frontrunners for the state’s two Senate seats.

item.title: Separados por um ponto: como está a disputa entre ACM Neto e Jerônimo na Bahia, segundo a Quaest
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll released on July 29, 2026 shows a technical tie between ACM Neto (União Brasil) and Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) in the Bahia gubernatorial race. In the first round, Neto leads with 39% to Jerônimo’s 38%, within the 3-point margin of error. In the second-round scenario, Neto holds 43% versus Jerônimo’s 39%, with minimal changes since April and stable rejection rates for both candidates.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Marina Silva accused Tarcísio of changing his electoral domicile to São Paulo in 2022 and of trying to privatize the generosity of the São Paulo people. She criticized those who use double standards when making such unfair claims.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: Tarcísio lidera em SP com 15 pontos à frente de Haddad
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows that São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leads the re-election race with 41% of voting intentions in the first round, 15 points ahead of Fernando Haddad (PT) at 26%. In a simulated second-round scenario, Tarcísio maintains his lead with 48% against Haddad's 32%. The poll has a margin of error of 2 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Quaest em São Paulo: Marina Silva, Simone Tebet e Pablo Marçal lideram corrida para as duas vagas ao Senado no estado
item.description: The Quaest poll shows Marina Silva (Rede) and Simone Tebet (PSB) leading the race for the two Senate seats in São Paulo, with 14% and 12% voting intentions, respectively, followed by Pablo Marçal (União Brasil) at 9% and Guilherme Derrite (PP) at 7%. A majority of voters (54%) say they may still change their vote, indicating high electoral volatility.

item.title: Quaest em São Paulo: 55% aprovam governo de Tarcísio, e 29% desaprovam
item.description: A Quaest poll shows 55% of São Paulo voters approve of Tarcísio de Freitas, while 29% disapprove, with a 2-point margin of error. The survey, registered with the Electoral Justice under number SP-04846/2026, also indicates that 55% believe he deserves re-election, compared to 38% who disagree. The highest approval ratings are for attraction of companies (49%), infrastructure and mobility (44%), and employment and income (39%).

item.title: Quaest na Bahia: ACM Neto e Jerônimo Rodrigues têm empate técnico na disputa para o governo da Bahia no 1º turno
item.description: Quaest poll shows a technical tie between ACM Neto (União Brasil) and Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) in the first round for Bahia governor, with 39% and 38% respectively. In a potential runoff, ACM Neto leads with 43% against Jerônimo's 39%. While government approval stands at 57%, security (47%) and employment and income (34%) are the top concerns among voters.

item.title: Quaest em São Paulo: Tarcísio tem 41%; Haddad, 26% no 1° turno
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads the São Paulo gubernatorial race with 41% of voting intentions in the first round, followed by Fernando Haddad at 26%. In a hypothetical runoff, Tarcísio expands his lead to 48% against Haddad's 32%, with Haddad facing higher rejection (58% vs 37%). The poll also shows 55% approval for the state government and mixed evaluations in sectors such as health, education and security.

item.title: Saiba quais pesquisas eleitorais podem sair nesta 4ª feira
item.description: Electoral studies registered with the TSE have been cleared for publication as of Wednesday, July 29, 2026, including national polls and regional surveys in seven states. The release adheres to transparency standards and legal timelines under electoral law. Poder360 promotes its Poll Aggregator as a resource for accessing historical and current voter intention data.

item.title: Saiba o que os pré-candidatos e candidatos ao Planalto farão nesta 4ª
item.description: Presidential pre-candidates Lula, Caiado, and Zema maintained institutional and regional agendas on Wednesday (Jul 29, 2026). Lula discussed climate emergencies with the Planning Minister, Caiado participated in the Abert/ANJ event and endorsed DF-area pre-candidates, while Zema held events in São Paulo and Minas Gerais, including radio interviews and party meetings. Other pre-candidates had no disclosed schedules.

item.title: Tarcísio lidera no 1º e no 2º turno na disputa pelo governo de SP
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas leading the race for São Paulo governor in both first and second-round scenarios against Fernando Haddad. The governor has a 55% approval rating and 37% rejection, while Haddad faces 58% rejection. The survey interviewed 1,650 São Paulo voters from July 23 to 27, 2026, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: AtlasIntel: 51,2% desaprovam desempenho de Lula; 47,6% aprovam
item.description: An AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll released on July 28 shows that 51.2% of respondents disapprove of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's performance, while 47.6% approve, indicating a slight improvement in approval compared to the late June survey. The poll has a margin of error of one percentage point and a 95% confidence level, based on 5,000 interviews conducted between July 22 and 27.

item.title: Eleição de Flávio causa mais preocupação que reeleição de Lula
item.description: An AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll from July 2026 shows 46.6% of voters are more concerned about Flávio Bolsonaro’s election than Lula’s re-election (44.6%), despite Lula leading in 12 of 13 government policy areas, with a 10-point advantage on poverty and inequality. The only tie was in public safety, where each receiving 46%20received 46% trust.

item.title: Desaprovação ao desempenho de Lula chega a 51,2%, diz AtlasIntel
item.description: The AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll shows 51.2% of Brazilians disapprove of Lula’s government, compared to 47.6% who approve, signaling a shift in public sentiment. Government evaluation is largely negative, with 49.3% rating it as 'bad/terrible' and only 37.9% as 'excellent/good'. Conducted between July 22–27, 2026, with 5,021 respondents, the survey has a 1-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Lula lidera no 1º turno e vence todos os adversários no 2º turno
item.description: Lula leads the first round with 49.2% voting intention and defeats Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential runoff with 49.2% to 42.9%, according to an AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll from July 2026. The survey, with a 1-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, also tested scenarios featuring Alckmin and Haddad against Bolsonaro. The study was registered with the TSE under BR-08602/2026 and cost R$ 80,000.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: Lula lidera todos os cenários de 1º e 2º turnos na BA
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leading presidential voting intentions in Bahia with 52% in the first round and 56% in a simulated second-round matchup against Flávio Bolsonaro (18% and 23%, respectively). 62% of Bahia voters have already made a definitive choice, signaling early consolidation of the electorate. In the Bahia gubernatorial race, ACM Neto (União) leads with 39%, technically tied with Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) at 38%.

item.title: AtlasIntel: Lula tem 49,2% contra 42,9% de Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll shows Lula leading with 49.2% of voting intentions against 42.9% for Flávio Bolsonaro in a hypothetical 2026 presidential runoff, with a margin of error of ±1 percentage point. Lula leads in all tested scenarios, including matchups against Michelle Bolsonaro, Jair Bolsonaro, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, and Renan Santos. His lead has remained stable at around 6.3 points since the June survey.

item.title: O que mudou na briga Tarcísio x Haddad após desistência de dois rivais de direita, segundo a Quaest
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas with 41% voting intentions in the first round against 26% for Fernando Haddad, maintaining an 11 to 15-point lead. The withdrawal of two right-wing candidates (Kim Kataguiri and Paulo Serra) gave Tarcísio a slight boost, up 3 points since April, while Haddad remained stable at 26%. In the runoff, Tarcísio leads with 48% versus Haddad's 32%, indicating a victory margin of 12 to 16 points.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: ACM Neto e Jerônimo empatam nos dois turnos na Bahia
item.description: Genial/Quaest poll shows ACM Neto (União Brasil) and Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) technically tied in the first round of the Bahia gubernatorial race, with 39% and 38% voting intentions, respectively. The data indicates a tight contest between the two leading candidates for governor.

item.title: Ao menos três ‘Bolsonaros’ vão disputar vaga de deputado federal no RJ
item.description: Three candidates running for federal deputy in Rio de Janeiro have registered ballot names referencing the surname Bolsonaro, despite having no familial ties to former President Jair Bolsonaro. The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) confirms that Jean Carlos Dias Barbosa Lopes is among those who adopted such names. The practice reflects a tactical use of recognizable surnames to gain electoral visibility without actual family connection.

item.title: Gestão Tarcísio é aprovada por 63,8% e reprovada por 32,1%, diz Paraná Pesquisas
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) of São Paulo state has a 63.8% approval rate and 32.1% disapproval, according to a Paraná Pesquisas survey released on July 29, 2026. Approval increased slightly from June's 63.2%, with stronger support among men (71.2%) than women (57.3%). Voter evaluation of the government is positive for 46.0% and negative for 22.7%, with 16.7% rating it excellent and 29.3% good.

item.title: Paraná Pesquisas: Tarcísio mantém liderança de intenções de voto em SP
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads voting intentions for São Paulo governor with 48.5%, followed by Fernando Haddad with 35.1%, according to Paraná Pesquisas. The gap between them is 13.4 percentage points, above the 2.4-point margin of error. In a runoff scenario, Tarcísio would win with 51.8% and Haddad with 38.3%, while Haddad retains the highest rejection rate at 42.9%.

item.title: Treze pontos: a vantagem de Tarcísio sobre Haddad no 1º e no 2º turnos em SP
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas leads the race for the São Paulo state government with a 13-point advantage over Fernando Haddad in both the first round (48.5% to 35.1%) and second round (51.8% to 38.3%), according to a Paraná Pesquisas survey released July 29, 2026. Although the lead has decreased from 26 points in February, it remains strong enough to suggest a possible first-round victory, given that other candidates collectively trail below 4%. Haddad also faces higher rejection (42.9%) compared to Tarcísio (27.1%).

item.title: Mesmo com alertas, Raquel Lyra insiste em nome investigado pela PF
item.description: Pernambuco Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) persisted in her intention to include Congressman Eduardo da Fonte (PP) in her electoral ticket, despite receiving warnings about investigations targeting former mayor Miguel Coelho (União Brasil) before the STF. The alerts, linked to the Federal Police, did not deter her from moving forward with the political arrangement. The incident highlights internal tensions within her coalition amid judicial risks.

item.title: Durigan fala em “silêncio retumbante” da oposição sobre economia
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan criticized the opposition for lacking an economic agenda in the final stretch of Brazil's 2026 presidential race, describing their silence as 'deafening' on policy proposals. He defended the continuation of tax reform, strengthening the fiscal framework, and modernizing the state, arguing that lower interest rates could spur investment in critical sectors like AI and biofuels. Durigan also dismissed U.S. tariffs as politically motivated and false, citing Brazil's bilateral trade deficit and calling the measure an external political interference.

item.title: TJDFT livra Van Hattem por dizer que Lula “mandou roubar mais” no INSS
item.description: The Federal District and Territories Court of Justice (TJDFT) dismissed a moral damages lawsuit filed by the Workers' Party (PT) against Deputy Marcel Van Hattem (Novo-RS) over his remarks during the INSS CPMI, ruling they are protected by parliamentary immunity. Judge Delma Santos Ribeiro stated that although the language was offensive, the statements were inseparable from Van Hattem’s political role and oversight duties. Van Hattem welcomed the ruling as a defense of free speech and legislative independence against political intimidation.

item.title: Após críticas de Milei a Lula, compare PIB, inflação e desemprego de Brasil e Argentina
item.description: Following criticisms by Argentine President Javier Milei directed at Lula and Brazil's economy, analysts noted his remarks surprised even some of his allies, given his typically provocative style. A comparison of key economic indicators — GDP, inflation, and unemployment — shows Brazil currently outperforming Argentina in stability, despite its own domestic challenges.

item.title: Aliados de André do Prado enxergam Eduardo fora de chapa ao Senado
item.description: Allies of André do Prado and the São Paulo PL consider it certain that Eduardo Bolsonaro will step down from the Senate ticket as his substitute, following his June ineligibility ruling by the STF for obstruction of justice in the coup plot case. Although André publicly maintains that Eduardo remains on the ticket and that legal appeals could reverse the decision, behind-the-scenes sources admit the spot will go to another name, to be chosen by Eduardo’s political group, likely someone outside politics. André plans to discuss the matter with Eduardo in the U.S., while betting on rising poll numbers by being framed as 'Tarcísio’s candidate'.

item.title: PT aciona Justiça contra vídeo de Flávio com Milei, Lula e Janja
item.description: The Hope Brazil Federation (PT, PCdoB, PV) filed a legal complaint with the Electoral Justice against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for alleged premature electoral propaganda, claiming a video on his social media used AI to generate or manipulate images and voices of Flávio, Javier Milei, Lula, and Janja. The video depicts Flávio as a fighter jet pilot with the Brazilian flag, narrating a mission to 'save Brazil from the reds,' and was published before the PL national convention that formalized him as a presidential pre-candidate. The federation demands immediate removal of the content, a ban on similar future posts, and a fine of R$ 90,000.

item.title: Lula diz não ser 'louco' para brigar com EUA e China; Alckmin critica Milei
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that he is not 'crazy' to fight with the United States and China, and argued that Brazil must defeat superpowers through study and science. He emphasized education and innovation as key paths for national development, avoiding direct confrontation with the world's largest economies.

item.title: Prefeitos argentinos repudiam ataques de Milei e defendem Lula
item.description: The Argentine Federation of Municipalities (FAM) condemned the attacks by Argentine President Javier Milei against Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling them an 'unacceptable lack of respect' and a 'political and institutional affront' that embarrasses Argentina and harms the historic bilateral relationship. The entity apologized to the Brazilian people and expressed solidarity with Lula, stating that Milei’s remarks do not reflect the views of the majority of Argentines, who believe in fraternity, Latin American integration, and mutual respect. FAM warned that diplomatic confrontations between the two countries jeopardize investments, trade, jobs, and opportunities for both nations.

item.title: Gobernar sin fecha de caducidad: la ruta de Bukele para borrar los límites del poder en El Salvador
item.description: Nayib Bukele is running for a third consecutive term in El Salvador, having officially registered his candidacy for the 2026 presidential elections. His path to indefinite power includes constitutional reform to allow unlimited re-election, capture of the Supreme Electoral Tribunal, and the co-optation of democratic institutions such as the judiciary and legislature, dismantling checks and balances to consolidate authoritarian rule under a veneer of legality.

item.title: Insultos contra diplomacia
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei insulted Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva during a visit to São Paulo, calling him 'corrupt', 'socialist trash', and 'a convict', in a clear show of support for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. This verbal escalation reflects not only ideological differences but a deliberate and irresponsible approach to diplomacy by Milei, who prioritizes domestic provocations over mutual respect between nations.

item.title: Diplomacia carcerária é uma praga
item.description: The practice of prison diplomacy began in 2019 when Alberto Fernández visited Lula detained at the Federal Police in Curitiba. In 2025, with Javier Milei in power, Lula visited Cristina Kirchner, held in her Buenos Aires apartment, and posed with a sign demanding her freedom. The content is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Para 59%, Moraes agiu mal ao proibir Flávio de visitar Bolsonaro
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows 59% of voters believe Minister Alexandre de Moraes acted wrongly by banning Senator Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, while 36% view the measure as appropriate. The ban followed Flávio’s social media post of a letter from Bolsonaro, violating the ex-president’s social media restriction amid his house arrest for a 27-year sentence related to an attempted coup. The survey also found 59% support Bolsonaro’s continued house arrest, versus 35% who oppose it.

item.title: PSB oficializa Alckmin como vice de Lula nesta quarta; outros partidos de esquerda também apoiarão presidente nas eleições
item.description: The PSB formally confirmed Geraldo Alckmin as Lula’s running mate for the 2026 presidential election during a national convention in Brasília on Wednesday. The move solidifies the coalition with the PT, with Lula expected to attend. Alongside the PDT, which endorsed the ticket last week, parties such as PCdoB, PV, and PSOL have signaled support for Lula’s reelection, while the right remains fragmented with pre-candidates including Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), and Romeu Zema (Novo).

item.title: Lula fará primeiro giro eleitoral da campanha com passagens por Ceará, Bahia e SP no fim de semana
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will undertake his first electoral tour of the 2026 campaign, visiting Ceará, Bahia, and São Paulo over the weekend. On Friday evening, he will attend the convention formalizing Governor Elmano de Freitas' re-election bid in Ceará. On Saturday, he will participate in PT conventions in Bahia, supporting Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues, and in São Paulo, where he will be officially nominated as the party's presidential candidate for a seventh time, with the event moved from Brasília to São Paulo at his request.

item.title: Move Brasil: crédito para motoristas de app e táxi patina, e governo já prevê emprestar menos de um terço do previsto
item.description: The Move Brasil program, designed to finance car purchases for app and taxi drivers, is falling short of expectations: despite R$30 billion in available credit, the government estimates only R$5–6 billion will be lent — about one-third of the projected amount. A meeting with Lula revealed internal pessimism, criticism of banks for hindering loan disbursement despite federal guarantees, and acknowledgment that the initiative was driven more by political motives than economic necessity.

item.title: Governo prorroga Desenrola e leva renegociação de dívidas ao período eleitoral: entenda o programa
item.description: The government extended the Desenrola Brasil debt renegotiation program until August 31, aligning it with the start of the 2026 electoral campaign. The measure, requested by banks and requiring no new funds from the FGO, aims to benefit 10 million families and allow individuals to clear debts before accessing other credit initiatives like Move Brasil.

item.title: Datafolha: 59% dos eleitores acreditam que Moraes agiu mal ao proibir visita de Flávio a Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows 59% of voters believe Alexandre de Moraes acted poorly by banning Flávio Bolsonaro's visits to Jair Bolsonaro, while 36% support the decision. Additionally, 59% of respondents believe Bolsonaro should remain under house arrest, and 62% think he should not be allowed to use social media during this period. The poll surveyed 2,004 voters aged 16 and over between July 22–23, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: “Eu não vou desrespeitar o arcabouço fiscal”, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that financing outside the fiscal framework will be needed to boost investments in science, technology, and innovation, emphasizing this does not mean violating the fiscal rule. He advocated for a long-term plan with 10-year goals in strategic areas such as health, AI, and industry, and said Brazil must compete internationally through technological development, not confrontation with the U.S. or China.

item.title: Prudente diz que disputará Senado se tiver uma das 2 vagas na chapa de Celina
item.description: Federal Deputy Rafael Prudente (MDB) said he could run for Senate if his party secures one of the two spots on Celina Leão's (PP) ticket. Currently, those positions are reserved for Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) and Bia Kicis (PL), though there is speculation Michelle may withdraw, opening room for the MDB. The MDB convention is scheduled for Saturday (August 1), while the PP and PL conventions are set for Sunday (August 2).

item.title: Moraes dá 48 horas para Daniel Silveira explicar vídeo com Portinho
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes gave Daniel Silveira's defense 48 hours to explain a video in which Silveira expressed support for Senator Carlos Portinho's re-election, posted on X, which may violate a court order banning Silveira from using social media as part of his open-regime sentence. Silveira, sentenced to 8 years and 9 months for attempting to obstruct the functioning of government branches and procedural coercion, has served 5 years and 9 days, and his pardon by Bolsonaro was annulled by the STF in 2023. Following the ruling, Portinho removed the post, stating he aimed to prevent legal harm to Silveira.

item.title: Moraes cobra PGR sobre depoimento cancelado de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has requested the Prosecutor General's Office to comment on the cancellation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's scheduled testimony in an inquiry investigating alleged slander against President Lula. The senator's defense submitted a written statement claiming the post linking Lula to Maduro falls under political discourse and does not constitute defamation, but Moraes deemed the cancellation unjustified since Bolsonaro was properly summoned and failed to appear, even virtually.

item.title: Lula defende plano de defesa sem depender de sobras do Orçamento
item.description: President Lula defended a long-term plan to finance national defense, criticizing reliance on budget leftovers and stressing the need to invest in technology, modernize the Armed Forces, and protect strategic assets like the pre-salt and borders. He also proposed a 10-year science and technology investment plan requiring new financing sources.

item.title: Moraes dá 48h para Bolsonaro explicar vídeo com IA exibido em convenção do PL
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered Bolsonaro's defense to explain, within 48 hours, the use of his image and voice in an AI-generated video shown at the PL's National Convention. The ruling aims to determine whether the content constituted electoral manipulation or disinformation.

item.title: Moraes manda Bolsonaro explicar se autorizou uso de imagem de IA em convenção do PL
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered Bolsonaro’s defense to explain within 48 hours whether the former president authorized the use of an AI-generated video depicting him, which was shown at the PL party convention. The video was displayed during the event held on Saturday, January 25, 2026. The ruling aims to clarify potential violations of electoral law regarding the use of deepfakes in campaign contexts.

item.title: José Medeiros pede à PGR investigação sobre vídeo de IA com Lula
item.description: Federal deputy José Medeiros (PL-MT) requested the Attorney General's Office to investigate an AI-generated video simulating President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, portraying him as a young metalworker in a narrative of political resistance. He argues the video should be scrutinized under the same legal and technical standards applied to the AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro during the PL convention, which claimed Bolsonaro was 'imprisoned and silenced'. The video, posted on May 2, 2026, on Instagram by advertiser Edson Barbosa, features symbolic imagery of Lula as a factory worker, in prison, and speaking at rallies, ending with the PT logo.

item.title: Moraes manda Bolsonaro explicar vídeo de IA — e clã pode ter problemas independentemente da resposta
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes has ordered Bolsonaro's defense to clarify within 48 hours whether he authorized the use of his image and voice in an AI-generated video shown at the PL convention supporting Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy. Regardless of the response, the Bolsonaro family may face consequences: if authorized, it could violate house arrest conditions and lead to re-incarceration; if not authorized, the unauthorized use may constitute an illegal deep fake under electoral law, subject to sanctions by the Electoral Justice.
